describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile standing on a plain light background. Its entire body except the back is covered in dense, shaggy brown fur that is dark brown on the lower legs and hindquarters and lighter tan-brown on the face, neck, chest and belly. The head is broad and bear-like with a blunt snout, dark eyes and a closed mouth. Two dark horns project from the face. A large, glossy, dark brown domed shell covers the whole dorsal surface from the back of the neck to the rump, with a smooth reflective surface, fine longitudinal ridges on the posterior half and a segmented rim along its lower edge. The animal stands on four thick, heavily furred limbs ending in clawed paws, and a small furry tuft of tail is visible at the rear beneath the shell.

describe.description: A large four-legged creature with the shaggy brown fur, head, ears, body, legs, clawed paws and small stub tail of a brown bear, shown standing in side view facing right. It has a long curved dark horn on its nose like a rhinoceros with a much smaller second horn between its eyes. Its entire back from behind the head to the rump is covered by a glossy dark brown domed shell in two sections, the front smooth and the rear with fine lengthwise lines, with a segmented rim around the lower edge.
